dashboard_period: Since launch · dashboard view: Last 1 Year

kpi_note.title: A new view of booking demand
kpi_note.text: Booking Opportunities Captured was introduced last week, so 175 is a partial-period baseline rather than a since-launch total. It counts calls where someone expressed an intent to book, play or reserve and SpeakSport took the correct next action—sending the booking link or transferring the caller to staff.

highlights.title: Booking intent converted into an immediate next step
highlights.summary: When a caller wanted a tee time, SpeakSport recognised the intent and delivered the online booking route without requiring staff involvement.
highlights.quote: Caller: “Looking for a tee time today.” SpeakSport offered to text the direct booking link; after the caller agreed: “I’ve just sent that link straight to your phone.”

highlights.title: Special booking rules triggered the right hand-off
highlights.summary: SpeakSport distinguished a Youth on Course request from a standard online booking and connected the caller with the golf shop for the reservation that required staff support.
highlights.quote: “For Youth on Course tee times at the $5 rate, those must be booked directly with our golf shop. Would you like me to transfer you?”

highlights.title: Practice-facility questions resolved on the call
highlights.summary: Callers received precise operating information immediately, avoiding an unnecessary transfer for routine questions.
highlights.quote: Caller: “Driving range hours.” SpeakSport provided the weekday, Tuesday and weekend opening times and confirmed that the range closes at dark each day.

features_intro: For Bobby Jones, we have focused recent improvements on capturing booking demand reliably, giving callers the right online path and making each hand-off easier to understand.

features.title: Booking-opportunity tracking
features.description: The new KPI makes previously invisible booking demand measurable, including both text-link delivery and appropriate transfers to staff.

features.title: Stronger booking-intent recognition
features.description: SpeakSport is better able to recognise when a caller wants to book, reserve or play—even when speech recognition turns “tee time” into something less obvious.

features.title: Clearer online-booking hand-off
features.description: Standard booking callers can receive the direct link by text, while exceptions and callers who need human help are routed to the golf shop.

features.title: Richer back-office reporting
features.description: The dashboard now supports filtering calls by intent, category and outcome, making demand patterns and operational opportunities easier to find.

future_note: We will continue enriching SpeakSport with capabilities such as self-serve knowledge-base updates and even better reporting. We would love Bobby Jones to remain part of that journey—please keep sharing feedback, ideas and initiatives you would like us to explore.

future_priorities.title: Self-serve knowledge base
future_priorities.description: Make it easier for your team to keep answers, hours and operating information current.

future_priorities.title: Even better reporting
future_priorities.description: Add clearer views of booking demand, link delivery, hand-offs and caller outcomes.
